title: Notes
notices: Three parts of the kickoff go by and every note was auto-written.
He comes in on his own, without going into the detail.

recorded.text: Hold on. Those notes were auto-written, not by you.
I want you to write this one.
Writing it yourself is how you learn it.

new.text: Hold on. Zero wrote those notes, not you.
Tomorrow, which of those numbers will you still remember?

lines.text: The check right after the kickoff asks about these numbers,
and your whole plan is built on them.
Notes are the easiest points you'll ever get.

lines: About $2.4M of pipeline lost a quarter

then: He goes, the app comes back, and the note is written.
He does not check it after.
